replies.body:
Do a map overview on display please.

Also, reduce the void gap, not many TNT cannons will make it to the other side well.

replies.author: kon333
replies.body: Wow! You improved the texture and look on the inside well but like people said up there, there is no room to set up cannons and the void gap is to large. I still suggest having a beach outside the vault door to allow room for bridging and cannons, it will also look good with the hills if done right
